outcome: Operative delivery (caesarean section or operative vaginal delivery)
cohort: Singleton births of viable foetuses in cephalic presentation with a gestational age ≥ 37 weeks delivered between 2016 and 2019
finding: The risk of operative delivery (Caesarean section and operative vaginal delivery) was significantly increased in women who received epidural analgesia during labor, even after adjusting for maternal and pregnancy characteristics.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia was associated with an increased risk of both Caesarean section and operative vaginal delivery.
